description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511828 (24/0392)
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Plot 1:203, Block 05) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and encumbrances. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land registration and title settlement matters.
